description: Exchange listings and delistings from the venues' own notices: what is SCHEDULED (with the exact time when the venue states it) and what happened in the last 'days' (default 7, max 30). Binance (futures instrument list: exact open/settle times; announcements when configured), Bybit and OKX (official announcement feeds) and Upbit. Delistings are announced 2–7 days ahead; new listings, Upbit and Binance especially, are among the most price-moving events. Coins and times are parsed from each notice's title and text: a notice that does not name them says so. Filter by coin ('symbol', comma-separated), 'kind' (listing, delisting, or all to include other trading notices such as pair removals, margin/collateral changes, migrations and postponements) and 'exchange'.

days.description: How many days back 'recent' reaches, 1–30. Default 7.

exchange.description: Binance, Bybit, OKX or Upbit. Omit for all.

kind.description: listing, delisting, both (default) or all (adds other trading notices)

symbol.description: Coin symbol(s), comma-separated, e.g. 'EPIC' or 'sol,eth'. Omit for all coins.

name: catalysts_exchange_listings

coins.description: Base tickers parsed from the notice; empty when it names none

effectiveMs.description: When trading opens or closes, when stated

market.description: spot or perp; null when the notice does not say

source.description: announcement or listing data (the venue's instrument list)

recent.description: Took effect (or, undated, was announced) within 'days', newest first

scheduled.description: Takes effect after asOfMs, soonest first

title: Exchange Listings
